split.selection_rule: fixed calendar partitions; highest validation expectancy among candidates passing the validation gate; holdout never used to choose

rules.entry: completed-candle rejection at a previously formed range edge; enter next bar open
rules.exit: range midpoint, stop beyond boundary by 0.35 ATR, or time exit
rules.intrabar: stop wins if stop and target occur in the same candle

exit_experiment.status: exploratory historical sensitivity; not an untouched holdout or selection rule
exit_experiment.runner: 50% at midpoint; 50% at opposite boundary; original stop unchanged
exit_experiment.cohort: paired to the baseline's exact signal, direction, and next-bar entry; runner observations may overlap
exit_experiment.costs: same fee and slippage per side, weighted by leg size
exit_experiment.intrabar: stop wins for all remaining size when stop and an unfilled target share a candle

walk_forward_screen.status: exploratory historical stability diagnostic; not an untouched holdout or selection rule
walk_forward_screen.window_length: six months; completed non-overlapping windows only
walk_forward_screen.assignment: continuous simulation; bucket by entry timestamp; do not reset or truncate positions at window boundaries
walk_forward_screen.promotion_effect: none; does not change validation, selection, holdout, or forward-paper labels

robustness_screen.status: exploratory historical fragility diagnostic; not an untouched holdout or selection rule
robustness_screen.cohort: exact range-walk-forward-v1 baseline signals, directions, entries, exit reasons, and exit timestamps
robustness_screen.drawdown_duration: maximum consecutive completed trades below the prior compounded-equity peak; days run from that peak to recovery or the final observed exit
robustness_screen.robust_rule: walk-forward stable, both directions sample-adequate and positive, and every cost scenario positive
robustness_screen.promotion_effect: none; does not change validation, selection, holdout, or forward-paper labels

forward_tracking.mode: candidate-level observation only; no real orders and no combined portfolio

forward_gate.status: prospective qualification screen; research label only and no real orders
forward_gate.promotion_effect: none; qualification permits further research only and does not authorize orders or ETH replication

verdict: No strategy earned a validated-edge label. Keep this in research mode; do not treat it as a signal service.
